hypothesis: Safely remove redundant work and contention without corrupting task semantics or degrading foreground use.
baseline_candidates: A bounded task runner with caching
scenario: Run compiler/test/agent workloads with and without ShareCLI, including truly identical pure work and deceptively similar non-coalescible jobs. Introduce input/config/credential differences, cancel a waiter, fail the producer and restart the supervisor. Maintain foreground game/audio workload constraints.
failure_cases: Improper coalescing shares data or skips side effects
Cancelled client terminates other consumers incorrectly
Tray and CLI disagree on ownership
metrics: Time to diagnose a failed job
